name: Tile request retry
summary: Retries transient raster and vector tile failures with bounded backoff.
prerequisites: OpenLayers tile sources created by XYZ

documentation.configuration: Add the entry URL to locale.plugins, tile_retry to locale.syncPlugins, and set locale.tile_retry to an empty object.
documentation.behavior: Retries transport errors and HTTP 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504 at most twice with capped backoff, jitter, and Retry-After support.
documentation.security: Runs as trusted same-origin JavaScript. Cross-origin raster sources retain their image loader because response status is unavailable without CORS.
